solver_config.regularizer: periodic latent-field nearest-neighbour quadratic; no template positivity
solver_config.damping: LM diagonal scaling in step system only; absent from acceptance objective

response_provenance.warning: All matrix numbers and flat-QE band responses are software fixtures, not physical CH/C2/AlO calibration.

coefficient_calibration.formula: alpha = sigmoid(power * log(rho / tau)); rho from cached physical raw residual
coefficient_calibration.calibration_inputs: training raw/cached-state residuals and training noise-kind metadata only; no truth MSE or validation scores

reproducibility_scope: Online inversion follows the same float32 scalar algorithm and frozen configuration. CPU/CUDA, library and floating-point differences can change PCG stopping and LM acceptance; equality to a historical cache needs a separate paired replay.
timing_scope: One synchronized call per stage; physical inverse and CNN measured separately. Model loading, host/device input transfer, diagnostics and file writes are excluded. This is not a warmed throughput or hardware real-time acceptance measurement.
